status: frozen before downloading or fitting fresh-suite datasets
development_evidence: The previous 12-dataset 48-configuration study is fully inspected and remains development evidence. This revision follows its results, not independent preregistration.
eligibility: Same input-only exact normalized-waveform deduplication as v2. No replacements or outcome-based exclusions.
backbone_selection: Fit MiniRocket and Hydra on official TRAIN. Choose one by calibration classification accuracy; tie by backbone name. The other remains an agreement feature only.
reference: Same strong v2 reference library, chosen by three-fold calibration log loss.
correction: Same 29 invariant spectral features and direct/offset learners. Bounds .125,.25,.5,1,2. Select candidate, bound and fixed bet jointly by maximum calibration out-of-fold mean log wealth over dimensionless fractions {0,2^-8,2^-7,...,2^-1}. No positive evidence forces no-update candidate with zero fixed bet.
gate: 0.95 times wealth from calibration-selected fixed bet plus 0.05 times original predictable adaptive wealth. Calibration and gate independent. Same positive expected proper-score target.
primary_unit: one pre-gate-selected policy per dataset, not all backbone/seed combinations
assessment_release: No fresh gate outcomes or assessment results inspected until all 10 selected policies are frozen. Progress logs omit gate outcomes.
primary_endpoints: assessment log-score gain vs frozen selected reference
aggregation: Equal dataset weight; 10000 dataset bootstrap replicates descriptive only. No seeds treated as independent replicates.
comparison: Replay old equal-weight mixture at family 10 and identical fitted candidates as a prespecified diagnostic, without using its outcomes to choose deployment.
success_interpretation: No guaranteed success. Positive authorization supports only the declared fitted-score claim. All failures and harmful changes remain reported. No further design changes from these validation outcomes.
sequential_monitoring: Not used; one terminal gate decision.
contingencies: Stop and report unavailable data or technical failures; no favorable-result substitution. Fix implementation bugs only with a documented amendment before unblinding, preserving original artifacts.
